title: i3 Unify 360: Comprehensive Solutions for Municipal Utility Billing and Customer Engagement
summary: The i3 Unify 360 platform consists of an end-to-end utility billing and CIS solution as well as a highly-configurable customer engagement portal.
body_markdown:

###### What Should You Look For in a Utility Software System?


Your exact needs will vary based on meter numbers, staff size, utility type, etc., but there are some key features everyone needs to succeed:


- **Navigation that anyone can master, no matter their technical skills:** A system is only as good as its usability. Your team has many specialized skills that may or may not include technology. A good solution will be quick for anyone to master and offer administrative options that can be performed without calling into IT or support.


- **Accessibility to data without sacrificing security:** For sensitive information like addresses and payment information, security is of utmost importance. Customers need to trust that payments made online are protected and that their personal information isn’t being leaked.


- **Flexible reporting options:** Reporting helps you better understand the state of your organization and its customers. Each utility has different requirements and preferences when it comes to reporting, so your systems should report on the metrics you need in that moment.


- **Integration capabilities:** An island is a great place for a vacation, not where your systems should be living. If you can’t connect systems, you’re missing out on data flows, automated tasks, and saved staff resources. With all the moving parts of utilities, your utility billing system should talk to meters, payment processing, financial systems, and more.


i3 Unify 360 includes all of these and more to give you the most value out of your system.
